label: The battery contract requires >=14 of 17 positives and zero negatives won by sk-code; it fails both legs today.
The recorded failure is positives 13/17, negatives-false-positive 2/5, identical before and after the round-four tie-break change.
The compiled graph signal map is built only from graph-metadata.json intent_signals plus derived affordance triggers.
description.json has no consumer anywhere in the advisor runtime; keyword additions there cannot move a route — corroborated by the round-two child's own known limitation.
The file-path pull is a bounded keyword lane: derived key_files/source_docs become derivedKeywords at max contribution 0.35 (derived_generated), against intent_signals at 1.0 (explicit_author).
No negative vocabulary lane exists: negative_keywords has zero occurrences in system-skill-advisor, so a doc/research prompt naming a skill can only add score.

Near-ties between surfaces are decided by the compiled routerPolicy.tieBreak order and generic words (typescript, vitest, json); the shipped mitigation is a caller-supplied surface hint applied at serve time.
Two live scorer surfaces: the battery drives the Python skill_advisor.py while the CLI front door spawns the TypeScript daemon CLI; an author can probe one and ship the other.

E3 root cause first half: four author-visible vocabularies exist but only two reach the scorer, only one of those is the author-lane that outweighs derived noise, and counter-signals have no lane at all.
